quests.name: CLUCK!
quests.text: Find some Special Chicken Feed and return to your befriended chicken. When you find it, /cheer at it before trying to give it the Special Chicken Feed.

quests.name: Furlbrow's Deed
quests.text: Bring Furlbrow's Deed to Farmer Furlbrow.

quests.name: Westfall Stew
quests.text: Verna Furlbrow wants you to deliver her recipe for Westfall Stew to Salma Saldean.

quests.name: A Swift Message
quests.text: Bring Lewis' Note to Thor the gryphon master.

quests.name: Dungar Longdrink
quests.text: Bring Osric's Crate to Dungar Longdrink the gryphon master.

quests.name: Continue to Stormwind
quests.text: Buy a gryphon ride from the gryphon master Thor, then bring Lewis' Note to Osric Strang, in the shop Limited Immunity, in the Old Town of Stormwind.

quests.name: Return to Lewis
quests.text: Buy a gryphon ride to Sentinel Hill from the gryphon master Dungar Longdrink, then take Osric's Crate to Lewis at Sentinel Hill.

quests.name: My First Alchemy Set
quests.text: Bring 5 Empty Vials, 5 Silverleaf, and 5 Peacebloom to the young, aspiring alchemist inside the barn of Moonbrook in Westfall.

quests.name: My First Real Potion
quests.text: Gather 3 Murloc Eyes for the young, aspiring alchemist inside the barn of Moonbrook in Westfall.

quests.name: The People's Militia
quests.text: Gryan Stoutmantle wants you to kill 15 Defias Trappers and 15 Defias Smugglers then return to him on Sentinel Hill.

quests.name: Goretusk Liver Pie
quests.text: Salma Saldean needs 8 Goretusk livers to make a Goretusk Liver Pie.

quests.name: The Forgotten Heirloom
quests.text: Farmer Furlbrow wants you to retrieve his pocket watch from the wardrobe in his farmhouse at the pumpkin farm to the West.

quests.name: Testing the Wells
quests.text: Use the Well Water Sample Kit to collect samples from the wells at the Jansen Stead and the Molsen Farm.

quests.name: Murloc Gills
quests.text: Alba Fairmoon wants you to collect 7 Longshore Murloc Gills along the shoreline of Westfall.

quests.name: Journey to Sentinel Hill
quests.text: Report To Gryan Stoutmantle at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.

quests.name: Westfall Stew
quests.text: Salma Saldean wants 3 Stringy Vulture Meat, 3 Goretusk Snouts, 3 Murloc Eyes, 3 Okra.

quests.name: Patrolling Westfall
quests.text: Bring 8 Gnoll Paws to Captain Danuvin on Sentinel Hill.

quests.name: The People's Militia
quests.text: Gryan Stoutmantle wants you to kill 15 Defias Pillagers and 15 Defias Looters and return to him on Sentinel Hill.

quests.name: Poor Old Blanchy
quests.text: Verna Furlbrow in Westfall wants you to bring her 8 Handfuls of Oats.

quests.name: The State of the Mines
quests.text: Slay 4 Kobold Diggers in the Jangolode Mine and 6 Riverpaw Miners in the Gold Coast Quarry.

quests.name: The Killing Fields
quests.text: Farmer Saldean wants you to kill 20 Harvest Watchers.

quests.name: Harvesting the Harvesters
quests.text: Ozwin Ironsprocket at Saldean's Farm wants you to bring him 14 Golem Isosprings and 5 Harvester Gyrostabilizers.

quests.name: Harvesting the Harvesters
quests.text: Bring the Precessive Autocognition Assembly to Ozwin Ironsprocket at Saldean's Farm.

quests.name: Harvesting the Harvesters
quests.text: Ozwin Ironsprocket at Saldean's Farm wants you to bring him 8 Golem Isosprings, 4 Copper Modulators, and a Crude Scope.

quests.name: Moonbrook Espionage
quests.text: Collect 8 Suspicious Industrial Supplies from Moonbrook.

quests.name: Thunderbrew
quests.text: Bring Grimbooze Thunderbrew 5 hops to complete his special brew.

quests.name: Red Leather Bandanas
quests.text: Bring 15 Red Leather Bandanas to Scout Galiaan at Sentinel Hill.

quests.name: Of Mice and Milk
quests.text: Get the mouse a cookie.

quests.name: Explosive Consultation
quests.text: Travel to the Dwarven District in Stormwind and find an engineer who can help.

quests.name: A Dynamite Plan
quests.text: Obtain 10 Coarse Dynamite from crafting, trading, or the auction house, then return to Sprite Jumpsprocket in the Dwarven District of Stormwind.

quests.name: Detonation at a Distance
quests.text: Talk to someone in Stormwind Intelligence about acquiring a remote detonator.

quests.name: Detonation at a Distance
quests.text: Bring the Remote Detonator Kit to Sprite Jumpsprocket in the Dwarven District of Stormwind.

quests.name: Explosive Consultation
quests.text: Return to Alba Fairmoon in Westfall.

quests.name: Keeper of the Flame
quests.text: Bring 5 Flasks of Oil to Captain Grayson at the Westfall Lighthouse.

quests.name: Captain Sander's Hidden Treasure
quests.text: Find Captain Sanders' footlocker and search it for the next clue.

quests.name: Captain Sander's Hidden Treasure
quests.text: Find the old barrel near the ruined chimney and search it for your next clue.

quests.name: Captain Sander's Hidden Treasure
quests.text: Search the empty jug next to the windmill for the next clue.

quests.name: Captain Sander's Hidden Treasure
quests.text: Locate Captain Sanders' chest and open it for your reward.

quests.name: The People's Militia
quests.text: Gryan Stoutmantle wants you to kill 15 Defias Highwaymen, 5 Defias Pathstalkers and 5 Defias Knuckledusters then return to him on Sentinel Hill.

quests.name: Destruction in Deadmines
quests.text: Use the detonator.

quests.name: The Defias Brotherhood
quests.text: Gryan Stoutmantle wants you to talk to Wiley in Lakeshire.

quests.name: The Defias Brotherhood
quests.text: Take Wiley's Note to Gryan Stoutmantle in Westfall.

quests.name: The Defias Brotherhood
quests.text: Take Wiley's Note to Mathias Shaw in Stormwind.

quests.name: The Defias Brotherhood
quests.text: Take Shaw's report to Gryan Stoutmantle in Westfall.

quests.name: The Defias Brotherhood
quests.text: Track down the Defias Messenger in Westfall and bring his message to Stoutmantle.

quests.name: The Defias Brotherhood
quests.text: Escort the Defias Traitor to the secret hideout of the Defias Brotherhood. Once the Defias Traitor shows you where VanCleef and his men are hiding out, return to Gryan Stoutmantle with the information.

objectives.text: Escort The Defias Traitor to discover where VanCleef is hiding

quests.name: The Coast Isn't Clear
quests.text: Kill 7 Tidehunters, 7 Warriors, 7 Oracles and 7 Coastrunners and return to Captain Grayson at the Westfall Lighthouse.

quests.name: The Coastal Menace
quests.text: Bring a scale of Old Murk-Eye to Captain Grayson at the Westfall Lighthouse.

quests.name: ... and that note you found
quests.text: Charred remains of the note serve as your only guide.

quests.name: Call of Water
quests.text: Speak to the Minor Manifestation of Water in Westfall.

quests.name: Klaven's Tower
quests.text: Steal the Defias Tower Key, break into the Defias Tower and uncover the contents of the Duskwood Chest. Take whatever information you find back to Mathias Shaw in Stormwind. Read Kearnen's Journal to gain insight about the tower.

quests.name: The Tome of Valor
quests.text: Defend Daphne Stilwell from the Defias attack.  Neither of your spirits must be released from their mortal coils if you wish to succeed.  After you are successful, speak to Daphne Stilwell again.

quests.name: The Tome of Valor
quests.text: Speak to Duthorian Rall in Stormwind.

quests.name: Sweet Amber
quests.text: Bring Holy Spring Water to Grimbooze Thunderbrew.

quests.name: Sweet Amber
quests.text: Grimbooze Thunderbrew wants a Sack of Barley, a Sack of Rye and a Sack of Corn.

quests.name: Sweet Amber
quests.text: Grimbooze Thunderbrew wants Truesilver.

quests.name: Sweet Amber
quests.text: Bring a Sycamore Branch to Grimbooze Thunderbrew.

quests.name: Sweet Amber
quests.text: Bring Grimbooze Thunderbrew a bundle of Charred Oak.
